title: Divergence: proof-backends §4 #224 closure (req ∪ ens ∪ body, body-closed) omits dec-MEASURE-position spec-calls; a measure denoted against the closure R_item affirms descent the source measure lacks, falsely discharging REGISTRY-TERMINATION (REQ-1.2) and re-opening Pin B

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Kernel-checked pin at lean/Thermite/PinDecMeasure.lean (builds clean against the shipped spine). Measure x - t(x), true registry t(x)=x: closure_measure_strictly_descends (denoted against the #224-closure R_item, t omitted, the dec call bottoms to 0 → measure denotes x, strictly descends on x → x-1) vs true_measure_never_descends (real measure x - x = 0, constant — the non-well-founded case REGISTRY-TERMINATION exists to reject). Authority: §4 hard gate's calledSpecFns seed = req ∪ ens ∪ body, closure step = spec-fn BODIES only — dec clauses (item's and reached spec-fns') are in no covered position; §1.2 binds REQ-1.2 to 'the SAME reachability set' while its obligations are ABOUT the dec measures; §1.2/§3.1 claim a divergent spec-fn 'FAILS this class on BOTH paths' — unjustified for spec-call-bearing measures (SpecFnItem.dec is a full Clause/Expr; nothing in thermite-design.md §4.1/§4.2 restricts it; shipped forge reachable_spec_fn_deps/collect_block_spec_fn_calls walk decl.body only, never decl.dec). Fix direction: extend the closure seed+step to include dec clauses, or normatively restrict dec to specCall-free and gate it.
